headline: Dr Lal PathLabs buys remaining 30% stake in Centrapath Labs
hook: Full ownership of Centrapath now consolidated
summary: Dr Lal PathLabs has acquired the remaining 30% stake in Indore-based Centrapath Labs. The transaction is executed through PathLabs Unifiers, a subsidiary of the diagnostic chain. This move grants Dr Lal PathLabs complete ownership of the healthcare and diagnostic services provider. The consolidation is part of the company's strategy to streamline its diagnostic operations.
why_it_matters: Full control may improve operational efficiency and margins for the company.
winners_losers: Dr Lal PathLabs gains / No clear losers

headline: Income Tax Department challenges tax relief granted to Dr Lal PathLabs
hook: Tax dispute returns for Dr Lal PathLabs
summary: The Income Tax Department has filed an appeal against a July 2026 appellate ruling that previously favored Dr Lal PathLabs. This legal challenge stems from an initial assessment order issued in April 2024. Following the news of the appeal, the company's stock price declined by 2.4%.
why_it_matters: Potential tax liability increase could impact company profitability.
winners_losers: Tax department gains / Dr Lal PathLabs hurt
